items.reason: A gentle, non-active cleanser keeps the routine simple while your skin adjusts to a retinoid.
A lower-strength retinol is a better first step toward smoother-looking skin than the 1% serum, and it is far less likely to cause irritation.
A ceramide moisturizer helps support the skin barrier and softens the dry-looking appearance your scan showed.
A daily mineral SPF 50 is essential alongside any retinoid, since it makes skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: Use the retinol at night only, starting 2 nights a week and building up slowly, and apply moisturizer after it. I held back the 1% serum and the retinal eye cream because using two retinoids at once is a lot for skin new to them, but the eye cream can be added later once your skin is comfortable.
